Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werebear under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this werebear's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The werebear shape-shifts into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid form or a Large bear, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Multiattack
